review_comments.body: **Required harness case is missing** This changes what HTTP clients receive, but the PR adds no case to `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json`. `AGENTS.md` requires one for every client-visible change under `transports/bifrost-http/`. Add a request to an unregistered `/api/*` path that checks the 404 status and JSON error through the server. This repository requirement must be satisfied before merging. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/ba4c90729b9216369eb0597d699baba43eb0f28d/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Dashboard test accepts an error** `TestServeDashboardKeepsNonAPIPathsOnTheSPAPath` uses an empty `embed.FS` and only checks that the body lacks `Route not found`. It passes when both paths return `404 - File not found`, without serving HTML. Use an embedded HTML fixture and assert a successful response with that content so the test protects the promised dashboard behavior.

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Limit this claim to GET requests.** `UIHandler.RegisterRoutes` registers only a GET catch-all. An unmatched POST such as `/api/no-such-route` still receives the router’s plain-text 405, not a JSON 404. Qualify the changelog entry so API clients do not rely on JSON for those responses. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fasthttp/router/v1.5.4/router.go))
